map.计算广告支出回报率（Return on Ad Spend），评估广告投放效果: Compute Return on Ad Spend, evaluating advertising performance
map.算每 1 元广告带来多少收入。: Compute how much revenue each 1 CNY of advertising brings.
map.由利润反推盈亏平衡 ROAS。: Back-derive the break-even ROAS from profit.
map.多Campaign 按 ROAS 排序砍低效。: Rank multiple campaigns by ROAS and cut the inefficient ones.
map.：花费 10000、广告收入 20000 → ROAS=20000/10000=: : spend 10,000, ad revenue 20,000 -> ROAS = 20000/10000 = 2.0x, profit = 10,000, net margin = 10000/20000 = 50%; break-even ROAS = 1 / gross margin.
map.：ROAS≥4 优秀、2.5–4 良好、1.5–2.5 一般、<1.5 较差；2: : ROAS >= 4 excellent, 2.5-4 good, 1.5-2.5 fair, below 1.5 poor; 2.0x sits at "fair", so improve the creative for efficiency.
map.看毛利率。毛利率 50% 时平衡 ROAS=2，刚好打平；毛利率低则已亏，需结合: Look at gross margin. At 50% gross margin the break-even ROAS is 2, exactly break-even; with a lower margin you are already losing, so read it with profit.
map.ROAS=收入/花费，ROI=(收入−总成本)/总成本，ROI 扣了货与固定成本: ROAS = revenue / spend, while ROI = (revenue - total cost) / total cost; ROI deducts goods and fixed costs and so reflects real profit better.
